body:
Fixes in [`be_an_ip_address`](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/1a0f69e/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb):

- **CIDR ranges matched:** `IPAddr.new` parses `"10.0.0.0/8"` as a network, so it passed. Addresses with a [non-host prefix](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/1a0f69e/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb#L22) are now rejected, via [`IPAddr#prefix`](https://github.com/ruby/ipaddr/blob/v1.2.8/lib/ipaddr.rb#L460).
- **Error handling:** it [rescues `IPAddr::Error`](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/1a0f69e/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb#L29), the parent of both [`InvalidAddressError` and `AddressFamilyError`](https://github.com/ruby/ipaddr/blob/v1.2.8/lib/ipaddr.rb#L90-L98), instead of [only the first](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/0e7e7cb/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb#L32).
- **Messages:** RSpec now builds the failure messages from [`description`](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/1a0f69e/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb#L33). This fixes `nil` showing as `''` and the [`"an IPv4 localhost "`](https://github.com/dpep/rspec-networking/blob/0e7e7cb/lib/rspec/networking/ip_address.rb#L38) description, which was missing "address".
- The README now documents `.v6`.

**Behavior change:** CIDR strings no longer match.
